plugins.name: cachewraith-skills
plugins.description: Six engineering skills for Claude Code: an OWASP Top Ten security audit that names the category ID for every finding, a performance audit that reports evidence rather than vibes, a test skill that finds and uses the project's own runner, a branch-and-commit helper with a fixed naming convention, an API documentation generator that investigates real endpoints and publishes frontend-ready docs as an Artifact, and a release helper that bumps the version everywhere it lives in any ecosystem, then tags and pushes it.
